strings.clover.pluginIndex.title: Plugins
strings.clover.pluginIndex.intro: Plugins add bots, panels, themes, tools and more. Each asks for your OK before it runs.
strings.clover.pluginIndex.lookingDetail: Index entries don't say which parts they fill yet, so this searches by name.
strings.clover.pluginIndex.notReviewedDetail: From an index you added. Only the official index is reviewed.
strings.clover.pluginIndex.gateText: {name} says it may contain adult content. Clover keeps plugins like it off until you confirm you're 18 or older. After that, it asks for its OK like any plugin.
strings.clover.pluginIndex.indexesDetail: Where Clover looks for plugins. Indexes you add aren't reviewed.
strings.clover.pluginIndex.none: Your indexes have no plugins yet.
